title: Army transfer rejects 15,499 troops on 30 ships despite the measured original boundary
body:
Owner-requested restrictions audit found a source-supported boundary discrepancy, separate from whole-selection refusal.

[ArmyTransferCommandHandler.ExceedsFleet](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/src/IC2.Engine/Armies/Commands/ArmyTransferCommandHandler.cs#L361) rejects an increase when finalTroops > fleet.Ships * TransportTroopsPerShip. The [promoted supply/transfer report §3, U3/U3b](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-09-supply-providers-and-transfer-clamps.md) instead measures the original test ships < (troops+unit) div500: 30 ships ACCEPT15499 but REFUSE15500. Exact multiplication and truncating division differ on the intervening499 troops.

Native production dispatcher probe at released4d70275a, classical-faithful rules and public synthetic state: 30-ship fleet carries receiver15000, adjacent donor gives one499-troop unit and retains a1000-troop unit. Result rejected=True, code armies.army-transfer-fleet-cannot-carry. Probe exit0. This confirms current port behavior; original result comes from the existing Wine U3/U3b experiment, not a newly run game.

The capacity detail was buried in closed umbrella #802 comments; search found no dedicated live correction issue. Human embark and mercenary hiring use similar multiplication, but need their OWN original boundary controls before copying this caller's policy. T216 AI whole-unit overflow and its owner-approved refusal remain separate.

Triage: correction contract should use loaded transport divisor, discriminate15499/15500 plus nominal15000 and two directions, avoid changing already-overcapacity armies on a non-growing operation, and preserve links/resources/moves/save behavior. This audit does not implement or assign a milestone.
